title: A charged-off loan's principal-only chargeback credits FUND_SOURCE 250.00 and debits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 250.00 (loan 16 L107)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the charged-off journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted, the principal-only shape, on the Tier-D Part2 MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION). request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 250.0 -> "25000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-16/loan-16-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L107 is the sweep's transactionId for the read-back's transaction id 107 (type Chargeback). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the read-back's chargeback transaction id 107: principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000", feeChargesPortion 0.0 -> "0", penaltyChargesPortion 0.0 -> "0", overpaymentPortion 0.0 -> "0"; the observed identity amount = principal + fee + penalty + overpayment holds (25000 = 25000 + 0 + 0 + 0). request.chargeback_journal.charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff true (fraud false); when charged off getPrincipalAccount / getFeeAccount / getPenaltyAccount resolve CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES / INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_PENALTY. request.chargeback_journal.accounts transcribes the product mapping LP2_DOWNPAYMENT_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_PROG_SCHEDULE_HOR_INST_LVL_DELINQUENCY_CREDIT_ALLOCATION: fundSourceAccountId 6, loanPortfolioAccountId 5, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 17, receivableFee/PenaltyAccountId 10, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 16, incomeFromChargeOffFees/PenaltyAccountId 14; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping (the one channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 19), so the default FUND_SOURCE 6 applies, exactly the account the observed credit names. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the 2 L107 legs in id order: JE 235 CREDIT account 6 250.0, JE 236 DEBIT account 16 250.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: on a charged-off loan the principal debit switches from LOAN_PORTFOLIO 5 to CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE 16 while the fund-source credit 6 is unchanged. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
